summary: The exec scope VM proof waits for systemd-run to join its scope before it reads the exec's placement, so a loaded VM no longer fails it.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no stored data is read differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Only crates/fractal-runtime/tests/scope_cascade.rs changes; the runtime is unchanged. The window it no longer races, a parent killed before the join, is tracked as an issue.
